title: Impact of Health Information Exchange Adoption on Referral Patterns
eligible_reason: Borderline, screened out. The treatment t1 is binary and staggered (practice joins the HIE: cohorts A10/A11/A12 switch on in 2010/2011/2012 with pre and post years; A9 is always treated 2009-2012; N = never treated within 2009-2012), so the cohort rule is met. But (i) the entire analysis sample is restricted to practices selected by coarsened exact matching ('oldmatch', CEM) - a matching-based comparison group, excluded by protocol; (ii) the first-listed estimator for each hypothesis is a Poisson GEE (proc genmod dist=poisson) with offset log(total referrals+2), i.e., nonlinear; (iii) the log-OLS variants also enter log total referrals as an offset (coefficient fixed at 1), which is an outcome transformation log((y+1)/(total+2)) rather than a control, so they would be linear TWFE - but without the article text it is unknown whether they appear in the main text. Only 4 annual periods.
design_notes: SAS code DID_MS1_1_new_Final.sas. Panel: physician (npi) x year 2009-2012 built from maindv_more merged with oldmatch (CEM-matched practices, 161 practices, 354 physicians, 1,416 rows). t1 = 1 if group in {A9: year>=2009, A10: >=2010, A11: >=2011, A12: >=2012} ('adoption at the beginning of the year'); group N (incl. A13/A14 adopting after 2012) never treated. Models: proc genmod with class npi year; model DV = t year npi / offset=log_Tot_phy [dist=poisson for Poisson]; repeated subject=Group_Practice_PAC_ID type=ind (practice-clustered robust SEs). Outcomes: DV1_s_phy (referrals sent to HIE members +1), Dv2_s_phy_m (sent to non-members +1), DV1_r_phy (received from members +1), Dv2_r_phy_m (received from non-members +1); offsets log(no_patient+2) / log(no_patient_rec+2). Event-time dummies tt3..tt_3 are constructed but not used in the models in this file. for_did_final.sas7bdat already contains t1, DVs and offsets.
n_adoption_cohorts_note: From for_did_final.sas7bdat (Gr x year): A10 (46 physicians, switch 2010), A11 (79, 2011), A12 (44, 2012) have pre and post periods; A9 (58) always treated; N (127) never treated in-sample.

specs.outcome: DV1_s_phy = no_pa_HIE_nsp+1 (referrals sent to HIE members)
specs.treatment_definition: 1 from the year the physician's practice joined the HIE (group A9..A12) onward
specs.sample_condition: for_DID = data11_p1 (CEM-matched practices, members and non-members)

specs.exclusion_reason: CEM-matched comparison group (protocol excludes matching-based DiD); main-text placement unknown. Otherwise a linear TWFE on transformed outcome log(DV1_s_phy) - log(no_patient+2)
specs.notes: Analogous log-OLS models at lines 254 (H2: Dv2_s_phy_m), 304 (H3: DV1_r_phy, offset log_Tot_phy_rec), 353 (H4: Dv2_r_phy_m). If the lead overrides the matching exclusion, these 4 are the candidate specs.

data_access: public (CMS referral data, Physician Compare, HEALTHeLINK enrollment, Census); final analysis file included
data_files: Final Datasets and Codes/for_did_final.sas7bdat (1.3 MB, SAS; 1,416 physician-years with t1 and DVs)
